review:
A 10-line mine with hard hats, shovels and coal trains. A plunger on the middle reel makes the detonations bigger, so you collect more dynamite.

Every three dynamite symbols increase the number of winning symbols in the game. Three feature symbols trigger free spins in three variations with 2x, 3x or 5x multipliers, where you mine rocks to unlock wins. 96.51% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
